name: Qualys SSL Labs Server Test
what: A free online test that grades the TLS configuration of a public web server: protocol versions, cipher suites, certificate chain and known TLS weaknesses.
when: After you publish or renew a certificate, change a load balancer or reverse proxy, or before an audit asks which TLS versions you still accept.
example: Open the Server Test and enter the public host name, for example `portal.contoso.com`.
Tick the option not to show the result on the public boards if you prefer it not to be listed.
Wait for the scan to finish; each IP address behind the name gets its own grade.
Work through the items that cap the grade (old protocol versions, weak ciphers, incomplete chain), then re-test.
pitfalls: It only tests servers reachable from the internet; internal hosts need a local scanner.
A host with several IP addresses can give different grades per node; fix every node.
The grade is a summary, not a compliance verdict; check what your own policy requires.
